content: Vercel Hobby free tier (2026): 100GB bandwidth/mo, 1M serverless function invocations/mo, 1M edge requests/mo, 4 hours Active CPU/mo, 60s function timeout, cron jobs limited to once-per-day cadence with only per-hour timing precision (not suitable for frequent automation polling), non-commercial use only per ToS (relevant since this is a commercial travel business - may need Pro $20/mo/seat for commercial use).
